outcome: lack of differentiation between cortical and subcortical layers
cohort: A single fetus diagnosed with isolated ventriculomegaly at 32 weeks gestation, later confirmed to have SCN2A epileptic encephalopathy and severe cortical dysplasia postnatally.
finding: The patient's findings expand the phenotype spectrum of SCN2A mutations to include epileptic encephalopathies with macroscopic brain developmental features.
